verdict.rationale: The documented install routes are all single shell commands an agent can run: `npx skills@latest add mattpocock/skills`, `claude plugin install`, and the codex/copilot plugin commands. A recorded runtime probe ran `npx -y skills add mattpocock/skills --skill tdd -a claude-code -y --copy` headlessly and installed the single skill end to end, with the SKILL.md reading back cleanly. Missing for 10: first-party docs that spell out the non-interactive flags (-y, -a, --skill) for agent use; the website describes an interactive 'pick the skills and agents' flow by default.
